content.value_statement: Funnel pricing and lock-in make simple feature comparisons unreliable. This skill compares real costs, ownership, maintenance, and exit risk for your situation.
actual_capabilities: Collects six business inputs that materially change a platform recommendation.
Calculates flat-fee, percentage-based, plugin, store-native, and self-hosted cost curves.
Finds the revenue point where percentage pricing exceeds a flat monthly plan.
Matches platform categories to technical capacity, store stack, client count, and data requirements.
Evaluates license claims, release maturity, paid-key requirements, data ownership, and cancellation risk.
States the main trade-off and hidden costs for each recommendation.
limitations: Vendor prices, plan limits, licenses, and free tiers require current verification.
The skill provides selection guidance, not legal, compliance, tax, or PCI advice.
It does not deploy, migrate, configure, or operate a funnel platform.
Recommendations depend on accurate revenue, contact, staffing, and catalog details.

use_cases.title: Select a First Funnel Builder
use_cases.description: Compare hosted options for a small business that needs a fast launch and has no technical operator.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Delivery
use_cases.description: Evaluate workspace fees, agency license terms, maintenance effort, and exit options across many client funnels.

use_cases.title: Replace Revenue-Based Pricing
use_cases.description: Compare a costly percentage plan with flat-fee, store-native, and self-hosted alternatives at current revenue.

prompt_templates.title: Make a Basic Recommendation
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a funnel platform category for my business. Ask for the six required inputs before deciding, then explain the main trade-off.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a structured starting point.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [platform A] and [platform B] for my case. Calculate current monthly costs and include fees, contacts, email, and migration labor.
prompt_templates.scenario: A buyer has narrowed the choice to two products.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Leaving a Vendor
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether we should leave [current platform]. Model our crossover point, migration work, data portability, downtime risk, and ongoing maintenance.
prompt_templates.scenario: An established team is reviewing an expensive incumbent.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Agency Decision Matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a weighted platform decision for [client count] clients. Include workspace pricing, license rights, integrations, support, ownership, and three-year exit costs.
prompt_templates.scenario: An agency needs an advanced standardization decision.

output_examples.input: We make $8,000 monthly, sell one course, and have no developer. Compare a one-percent plan with a $197 flat plan.
output_examples.output: Choose the percentage plan for now. At a $29 base fee, its crossover is $16,800 monthly revenue. Recheck before revenue reaches that point.

output_examples.input: Our agency manages 25 client funnels and already uses WooCommerce.
output: Primary fit: a WooCommerce funnel plugin with agency rights.
Verify site limits, renewal pricing, client-work permissions, and export behavior.
Avoid per-workspace platforms unless their support savings exceed the added client fees.

output_examples.input: We process high revenue and require orders in our own database. Our team can maintain deployments.
output_examples.output: Prioritize a self-hosted option. Validate releases, license terms, backups, payment integration, support, and three-year maintenance cost before selecting a product.

best_practices: Provide current revenue, funnel count, contact growth, store stack, operator skills, and exit tolerance.
Verify current prices, limits, licenses, and repository releases before accepting a recommendation.
Compare total costs over several revenue levels and include migration labor.
anti_patterns: Do not choose from feature counts without modeling cost and ownership.
Do not call a product open source without checking its license and usable release.
Do not recommend self-hosting when nobody can maintain backups, upgrades, uptime, and payments.

faq.question: Does this skill recommend one specific platform?
faq.answer: No. It selects a platform category from your constraints and can compare named products with current information.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide monthly revenue, funnel count, contact growth, catalog location, available technical support, and tolerance for vendor lock-in.

faq.question: Can it calculate a pricing crossover?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares a percentage plan with a flat plan and calculates the revenue where their monthly costs match.

faq.question: Does it verify current vendor pricing?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to check current prices. Results still depend on available and accurate vendor information.

faq.question: Can it assess open-source options?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks license type, repository substance, releases, paid-key requirements, maintenance effort, and operational ownership.

faq.question: Will it deploy or migrate my funnel?
faq.answer: No. It supports platform selection and cost analysis, but deployment and migration require separate implementation work.
